subject: Spirit Temple
text: The Spirit Temple is the only dungeon requiring both Young Link and Adult Link to finish, divided into the smaller West Wing for Young Link and the larger East Wing for Adult Link.

evidence.quote: The Spirit Temple is unique in that it is the only dungeon which requires both Young Link and Adult Link to finish (with the possible exception of Dodongo's Cavern, which contains a Skulltula only obtainable with Adult Link).  The Temple is divided into two wings: The West Wing, and the East Wing.  The West Wing is smaller, and is largely Young Link's territory.  The East Wing is much larger, and is Adult Link's stomping grounds.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: The Spirit Temple contains two dungeon items—one each for Young Link and Adult Link—though only Adult Link can use either of them.

evidence.quote: The Spirit Temple also contains two Dungeon Items, one each for Young Link and Adult Link (though Adult Link is the only person who can use either of them).

subject: Hylian Shield
text: Young Link should switch back to the Hylian Shield in the Spirit Temple due to fire-based enemies.

evidence.quote: Young Link is going to face a lot more fire-based enemies here, so change back to the Hylian Shield if you're use the Deku Shield.

subject: Nabooru
text: At the top of the entrance stairs in the Spirit Temple, Nabooru is found attempting to crawl into a small hole.

evidence.quote: At the top of the stairs, go to the left to find a Gerudo Thief trying to crawl into a hole that is far too small for her.  This is Nabooru, the second-in-command to Ganondorf that heard so many unpleasant things about as an adult.

subject: Nabooru
text: When speaking with Nabooru, telling her 'Nothing, really.' when she asks what you are up to leads her to ask for help fighting Ganondorf.

evidence.quote: Tell her "Nothing, really." when she asks what you're up to.  Past that, she'll ask you more questions, but it doesn't matter what your answers are.  Nabooru will ask  you to help her to - of all things - fight Ganondorf.

subject: crawlspace
text: After Nabooru moves aside, crawl through the crawlspace to proceed.

evidence.quote: Once Nabooru moves aside, crawl through the crawlspace yourself.

subject: Armos Knight
text: An Armos Knight can be defeated by dropping a bomb next to it and hitting it with a sword right before the bomb detonates, or by using Bombchus.

evidence.quote: Drop a bomb next to the Knight, and attack him with the sword just before the bomb explodes.  The explosion will then defeat the Knight.  If you screw up, use Bombchus to defeat him.

subject: Keese
text: In the Armos Knight Room, use the Boomerang to defeat the Keese on the wall above the crawlspace.

evidence.quote: Next, use a Boomerang to kill the Keese on the wall behind the Armos, just above another crawlspace.

subject: door left of crawlspace
text: Defeating all enemies in the Armos Knight Room unseals the doors, allowing passage through the door to the left of the crawlspace.

evidence.quote: Once you have killed all of the enemies in the room, the doors in the room will unseal themselves.  Go through the door to the left of the crawlspace.

subject: Stalfos
text: Defeat the Stalfos in the Stalfos Room by dodging its attacks and striking immediately afterwards.

evidence.quote: Run forward, and ten-year-old Link will have to fight a Stalfos. ... Dodge the Stalfos' attacks, and attack immediately after he does.

subject: Green Bubble
text: Stun the Green Bubble floating in the pit with the Boomerang and kill it with the Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Once you have beaten the Stalfos, face the pit with the Green Bubble floating around in it.  Stun the Bubble with the Boomerang, and defeat it with a Slingshot attack.

subject: Crystal Switch
text: Aiming the Boomerang to the left of the bridge allows it to hit the Crystal Switch behind the grating, causing the bridge to fall.

evidence.quote: You must now use the Boomerang to hit the Crystal Switch behind the grating.  Aim the Boomerang just to the left of the bridge, and it will hit the switch on it's way around, causing the bridge to fall.

subject: Anubis
text: Anubis enemies can only be defeated with Fire, such as using Din's Fire or triggering the room's fire trap.

evidence.quote: As you enter the room, you'll encounter a new, flying enemy: an Anubis.  These enemies can only be defeated with Fire. ... Use Din's Fire to kill it (you can also use the fire trap activated by the crystal switch in the room, but this takes far too long in my opinion).

subject: Anubis Pit Room door
text: Defeating the Anubis unseals the door on the right side of the room.

evidence.quote: Once the Anubis is defeated, the door on the right side of the room will unseal itself.  Go through it.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees from the grating creates a bridge in the middle of the room.

evidence.quote: Once all of the Silver Rupees are gathered, then a bridge will appear in the middle of the room, breaking the grating wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Across the bridge in the Lower Silver Rupee Chamber, kill the Gold Skulltula on the right side of the grating with the Boomerang to claim its token.

evidence.quote: Once on the other side of the bridge, turn around to face the grating.  There is a Gold Skulltula on the right side of the grating.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang

subject: chest
text: Lighting the two torches near the wall with Din's Fire spawns a chest containing a Small Key on the other side of the bridge.

evidence.quote: then light both of the torches near the wall with Din's Fire.  The lit torches will make a chest appear back on the other side of the room.  Run back across the bridge and open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: crawlspace
text: In the Armos Knight Room, enter the crawlspace to the right of the door to reach the Small Hall.

evidence.quote:
You'll come out of the door on the right side of the Armos Knight Room.  To the right of the door as you come out is a crawlspace.  Go through it to it's other side.

-------------------------------
The Spirit Temple - Small Hall

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the top of the tiled wall in the Sun Cavern, turn around to find a Gold Skulltula and retrieve its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: At the top of the tiled wall, turn around to find another Gold Skulltula.  Use the Boomerang to kill it and take it's token.

subject: sun panel
text: Blowing up the rock on the wall with a Bombchu reveals sunlight that hits the sun panel on the floor, unsealing the opposite door.

evidence.quote: Use a Bombchu to blow open the rock (if you don't have any Bombchus, then activate the Crystal Switch on the wall to make a chest of them appear).  The rock will be blown to pieces, revealing a patch of sunlight that will shine on the sun panel on the floor.  The sun will light up, unsealing the door on the opposite wall.

subject: statue
text: Pushing the statue off the cliff makes it land on a button, unsealing a door on an upper level.

evidence.quote: As you come out of the door, there is a statue near you.  Grab hold of it, and push it off the cliff on the other side of the statue.  It will fall, landing on a button.  The button will unseal a door on an upper level.

subject: chest
text: Lighting the pair of torches in front of the Colossus statue with Din's Fire reveals a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Run towards the center of the room, near the front of the Colossus statue, where you will find a pair of torches.  Light them with Din's Fire to make a chest appear.  Open it to get the Dungeon Map.
